description: This file defines a PHP class 'Map' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Dashboard'. It contains methods for managing dashboard map-related functionalities in an OpenCart admin extension, including displaying the map, saving settings, returning map data, and generating dashboard views.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Controller class handling dashboard map functionalities in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the dashboard map configuration page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard map settings via POST request.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a view with dashboard map information.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Retrieves map data, including orders by country, and outputs it as JSON.
